getOrders.body: {"query": "query getDropshipPurchaseOrders {getDropshipPurchaseOrders (limit:100,hasResponse: false,fromDate: \"2026-10-24\") {poNumber,poDate,estimatedShipDate,customerName,packingSlipUrl,shippingInfo {  shipSpeed,  carrierCode}warehouse {  id,  name,  address {    name,    address1,    address2,    address3,    city,    state,    country,    postalCode  }},products {  partNumber,  quantity,  price,  name,  estShipDate,  event {    id,    type,    name,    startDate,    endDate  }},shipTo {  name,  address1,  address2,  address3,  city,  state,  country,  postalCode,  phoneNumber}}}", "variables": null}

getInventory.body: {"query": "query inventory { inventory(limit: 10) {  supplierPartNumber,  quantityOnHand,  quantityBackordered,  quantityOnOrder, discontinued,          itemNextAvailabilityDate  }  } ", "variables": null}

acceptOrder.body: {"query": "mutation accept {            purchaseOrders {              accept (                poNumber: \"CS123\",                shipSpeed: GROUND,                lineItems: [                   {                      partNumber: \"SKU-1\",                      quantity: 2,                      unitPrice: 10.50,                      estimatedShipDate: \"2024-05-06\"                      } , {                      partNumber: \"SKU-2\",                      quantity: 1,                      unitPrice: 5,                      estimatedShipDate: \"2024-05-07\"                      }                 ]              ) {                id,                handle,                status,                submittedAt,                completedAt,                errors {                  key,                  message                }              }            }          }", "variables": null}

rejectOrder.body: {"query": "mutation reject {      purchaseOrders {        reject (          poNumber: \"CS123\",          lineItems: [             {                partNumber: \"SKU-1\",                quantity: 2                } , {                partNumber: \"SKU-2\",                quantity: 1                }           ]        ) {          id,          handle,          status,          submittedAt,          completedAt,          errors {            key,            message          }        }      }    }", "variables": null}

updateFullInventory.body: {"query": "mutation save (      $inventory: [inventoryInput]!    ) {      inventory {        save (          inventory: $inventory,          feedKind: TRUE_UP        ) {          id,          handle,          status,          submittedAt,          completedAt,          errors {            key,            message          }        }      }    }", "variables":  {      "inventory": [       {          "supplierId": 49188,          "supplierPartNumber": "A-1",          "quantityOnHand": 5          } , {          "supplierId": 49188,          "supplierPartNumber": "B-2",          "quantityOnHand": 0          }     ]}}

updateInventory.body: {"query": "mutation save (      $inventory: [inventoryInput]!    ) {      inventory {        save (          inventory: $inventory,          feedKind: DIFFERENTIAL        ) {          id,          handle,          status,          submittedAt,          completedAt,          errors {            key,            message          }        }      }    }", "variables":  {      "inventory": [       {          "supplierId": 49188,          "supplierPartNumber": "A-1",          "quantityOnHand": 5          } , {          "supplierId": 49188,          "supplierPartNumber": "B-2",          "quantityOnHand": 0          }     ]}}

log.body: {"query": "mutation register {        purchaseOrders {          register (            registrationInput: {              poNumber: \"CS123\",              warehouseId: 49188            }          ) {            id,            consolidatedShippingLabel {              url            }          }        }      }", "variables": null}
